The '''Imperial Officer Corps''' was a unit within the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] hierarchy that included various [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]. It had a prestigious history that dated as far back as the [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commandos]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Members of the Officer Corps who were demonstrated to be the most cunning, dedicated, and excelled were often chosen to become [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]].
